# The Locked Door

Mara reached the archive before the last bell. The clerk covered the register
with one hand and asked who would answer for her.

She placed her final coin beside the seal. “No one. Record the request under my
own name.”

The clerk took the coin, opened the register, and left a blank where a sponsor
should have been. By sunset, the blank would become either permission or proof
that she had challenged the rule.
